The WYSIWYG editor bundle (wissen-editor.js) is built from the packages below
(see editor/ in the source tree for how). Each is used under its own licence;
the licence texts are part of the packages on npm.

ProseMirror – Copyright (C) 2015-2017 by Marijn Haverbeke and others – MIT
unified / remark / mdast / micromark – Copyright (c) Titus Wormer and contributors – MIT
